title: What came between Battle of Trancoso and Battle of Valverde?
question: What came between Battle of Trancoso and Battle of Valverde?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Battle of Trancoso (1385) to Battle of Valverde (1385): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
